::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 31st 1889  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 167
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I am very glad you approve of ‘[the Reputed Changeling](cmy_books/cmybook_205.qmd)’ for a name.

He shall come on the 18th or 19th as soon as I have read him to an old friend and critic with whom I am  going to stay on the 11th - when I shall put some last touches and corrections.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
